item.description: WASHINGTON (AFP) : US President Donald Trump will try to sell voters on the record of his first year back in power during his State of the Union address Tuesday, despite suffering a series of stinging blows ahead of November’s crucial midterm elections. item.title: UK police release ex-envoy Peter Mandelson on bail in Epstein case
item.description: LONDON (AP) : London police released former ambassador Peter Mandelson on bail in the early hours of Tuesday, in a probe into his ties to disgraced US financier Jeffrey Epstein, only days after ex-prince Andrew was arrested. item.title: China acts against 40 Japanese entities over military ties
item.description: BEIJING (AFP) : China’s commerce ministry took action against 40 Japanese companies and entities on Tuesday, citing national security concerns over their military ties. It imposed export controls on 20 entities, including Mitsubishi and the Japanese space agency, accusing them of helping to enhance Japan’s military capabilities.
